description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of data across six distinct categories, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and its proportional share. The chart is composed of six colored segments, each labeled with its category name and percentage: the largest segment, a prominent pinkish-red slice, represents "chat" at 41.2%; a large blue segment represents "math" at 21.9%; a green segment represents "tooluse" at 11.6%; an orange segment represents "multi turn chat" at 10.0%; a light purple segment represents "code" at 9.0%; and a small pink segment represents "instruction follow" at 6.9%. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that maps each color to its respective category and provides the raw count for each, which corroborates the percentages shown on the chart. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending in size from largest to smallest, starting with "chat" and ending with "instruction follow".
